decision_notes: Argentine provincial legislature with substantive provincial legislation under Constitution Articles121–123. Legislature identity Q41144338 matches the official provincial institution, not a municipal deliberative council.

Official provenance and proceedings: The official institution homepage/live page links this exact provider channel. Actual proceedings from the 8 and 21 October 2026 ordinary sittings play beyond opening graphics. The embedded live-page recording did not start on this attempt; normal public watch pages did. The official agenda has different ordinal session numbers from the provider titles, so dates, institution, chamber footage and exact provider IDs are retained without claiming an exact event-number reconciliation. Committee and current live coverage remain unvalidated. A sign-language interpreter is visible in one sampled recording; language and full-service coverage are unreviewed.

Source conditions: Institutional/provider pages establish public viewing but no independent audiovisual reuse permission was found. Retain the official link-out; provider manifest extraction, embedding and redistribution are not enabled.
